items.title: Lionel Ferbos Interview, 1964-08-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...And they had Baby Briscoe. ... [INTERVIEWEE] I met his brother...

ctx.x: And then he was playing trombone with him. And then he was playing with Faith's all the time. And then I even took a license with Albert Snyder. He used to work on the Capitol with Faith too for a long time. And the band with Robichaud, you remember?
I don't know if you remember. Joe Robichaud? Joe Robichaud? And they had Baby Briscoe. Oh yeah, and that bunch there, and all that bunch there.
